message: The exact-hit canonical active-face kernel cannot be revised in place under fixed finite-population potential outcomes, the required legal variance box, and a primitive covariance functional containing every cross-coordinate covariance. The obstruction changes the Gaussian criterion, the mass-floor equality theorem, and the worked active-pair receipt, so silently retaining the prior core would be unsound.

mathematical_obstruction.primitive_score: For the exact assignment-cell mean estimator, let \(\mu_{C,b,z}=C_b^{-1}\sum_{c\in I_{C,b}}W_c(z)\), \(g_{C,b,c,k}=M_k^{-1}\sum_{z\in\mathcal S_k}\{W_c(z)-\mu_{C,b,z}\}\), and \(\psi_{C,b,c,k}=r_{C,k}^{-1}\mathbf 1\{Z_c\in\mathcal S_k\}\{W_c(Z_c)-\mu_{C,b,Z_c}\}\).
mathematical_obstruction.full_covariance: Writing \(A_{C,b,k}=C_b^{-1}M_k^{-1}\sum_{c\in I_{C,b}}\sum_{z\in\mathcal S_k}\{W_c(z)-\mu_{C,b,z}\}^2\) and \(\Xi_{C,b,k\ell}=C_b^{-1}\sum_{c\in I_{C,b}}g_{C,b,c,k}g_{C,b,c,\ell}\), the exact design covariance is \(\Sigma_{C,b}(r_C)=\operatorname{diag}(A_{C,b,k}/r_{C,k})-\Xi_{C,b}\). Thus the cross-coordinate entries are \(-\Xi_{C,b,k\ell}\), not zero in the unrestricted fixed-schedule class, and the diagonal also contains the finite-population correction \(-\Xi_{C,b,kk}\).
mathematical_obstruction.nonidentification: One realized assignment per cluster reveals no within-cluster products of \(W_c(z)\) across mutually exclusive assignments. Permuting a fixed assignment cell's potential outcomes across clusters preserves every assignment-cell empirical marginal while changing \(\Xi_{C,b}\); no design-unbiased estimator of those cross-products is available, and unrestricted triangular arrays preclude uniform recovery from one assignment per cluster. Hence a pilot statistic cannot uniformly recover the full covariance without a new coupling restriction, repeated cluster assignments, or a covariance-set formulation.
mathematical_obstruction.failed_homogeneity: If all target-hit rates are thinned by \(s\in(0,1)\), then \(\Sigma_{C,b}(sr)=s^{-1}\Sigma_{C,b}(r)+(s^{-1}-1)\Xi_{C,b}\), rather than \(s^{-1}\Sigma_{C,b}(r)\). Therefore the identity \(G_A(v,sr)=s^{-1/2}G_A(v,r)\), the stated mass-floor equality criterion, and the reported active-pair ratio do not follow from the fixed finite-population experiment.
mathematical_obstruction.worked_endpoint_contradiction: For the required menu \(n_0=6\), \(m=(1,2,4)\), the slices for \(m_2\) and \(m_3\) have \(M_k=15\). At a full tie with \(A_{C,b,k}=1/4\), every assignment-cell welfare must be binary with cell mean \(1/2\). For each fixed cluster, the number of welfare-one assignments among 15 cells is an integer, so \(|g_{C,b,c,k}|\ge1/30\) and \(\Xi_{C,b,kk}\ge1/900\). Consequently the required covariance coordinate \(1/(4r_k)\) is unattainable: the actual coordinate is at most \(1/(4r_k)-1/900\). This directly contradicts the retained claim that the whole box \([1/8,1/4]^3\) yields covariance \(\operatorname{diag}(v_k/r_k)\) at a fixed binary full-tie baseline.
mathematical_obstruction.why_revision_is_insufficient: Repairing the defect requires changing at least one preserved element: replace fixed finite-population assignment-only randomness by sampled schedules; enlarge the Gaussian input to \((A,\Xi,r)\) and rederive the exact-hit mechanism theorem and numerical receipt; restrict the attainable variance domain and impose a disclosed cluster-balanced coupling condition; or formulate a robust covariance-set certificate. Each option changes the theorem-level kernel rather than patching a flagged field.
mathematical_obstruction.baird_primary_check: The public July 2017 author manuscript was opened. Theorem 1 on manuscript page 14 gives individual-saturation and slope standard errors, and Theorem 2 on manuscript page 20 gives the pooled intention-to-treat standard error under constant treatment and spillover effects. Section 3 uses those formulas for power-oriented design. The prior description of Theorems 1 and 2 as optimal-allocation theorems is not retained.

directives_checked: The three observation blocks, cell-mean estimators, measurable selector, auxiliary randomization, design-to-rate maps, and full covariance functional were derived before the obstruction was declared.
A common baseline-plus-local family with fixed compact local-parameter cubes was separated from any expanding diagonal schedule.
The shrinking covariance-neighborhood condition was treated as novel rather than attributed to Hirano and Porter.
The Baird primary manuscript and theorem text were checked directly.
The six-unit binary endpoint was tested with all covariance corrections, producing the contradiction above.

literature_checklist.author: Baird, Bohren, McIntosh, and Ozler
literature_checklist.one_line: The public author manuscript's Theorems 1 and 2 are standard-error formulas; Section 3 develops power-oriented saturation design from them.

literature_checklist.author: Hirano and Porter
literature_checklist.one_line: Provides the smooth local asymptotic treatment-rule comparison but not the exact shrinking covariance-neighborhood condition required here.

literature_checklist.author: Jiang, Imai, and Malani
literature_checklist.one_line: Shows why randomization-based covariance analysis for two-stage experiments must respect finite-population cross-potential-outcome limitations.

literature_checklist.author: Aronow, Green, and Lee
literature_checklist.one_line: Sharp randomization-variance bounds underscore that unobserved cross-potential-outcome couplings cannot generally be replaced by an identified diagonal covariance.

literature_checklist.author: VanderWeele and Tchetgen Tchetgen
literature_checklist.one_line: Distinguishes fixed-proportion and independent-Bernoulli mechanisms but does not remove the finite-population covariance coupling obstruction.

literature_checklist.author: Li and Ding
literature_checklist.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
literature_checklist.one_line: Finite-population central limit theory carries the exact design covariance, including its finite-population correction, into the Gaussian limit.
